title: FinFlowSessionTokenClaims
description: Claims specification for FinFlow Access Token JWTs issued by Module 2 (Authentication)

sub.description: Session-obfuscated user identifier. NEVER raw database UUID.

sid.description: Unique session identifier matching the active Redis session key.

roles.description: List of assigned roles, e.g. ['END_USER'] or ['ADMIN'].

privileges.description: List of atomic privileges in MODULE:OPERATION format, e.g. ['AUTH:LOGIN', 'TRANSACTION:READ'].

exp.description: Expiration UTC epoch timestamp (15 minutes after issuance).
